answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 4379 Country: India Title: My question is related to wuzu. Suppose a person has entered in the bathroom to take his bath.After entering he completely wear off all his clothes but he has performed all the farz of "gusul" while taking bath and then he comes out wearing his clothes. Now my question is does his wuzu remain so that he can offer namaaz? Question: My question is related to wuzu. Suppose a person has entered in the bathroom to take his bath.After entering he completely wear off all his clothes but he has performed all the farz of "gusul" while taking bath and then he comes out wearing his clothes. Now my question is does his wuzu remain so that he can offer namaaz? Answer ID: 4379 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 606/566=L/1429) Yes, if there is nothing occurred which nullifies wuzu then his wuzu shall remain intact and he can perform salah from that wuzu . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
